problems.title: Differentiate a sine with inner factor two
problems.question: Find f′(π/4) if f(x)=sin(2x).
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: At x=π/4,the cosine is cos(π/2)=0. Thus f′(π/4)=0.

problems.title: A definite polynomial integral
problems.question: Evaluate the integral of 3x²+x from 0 to 2.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: Evaluate at the endpoints: (8+2)−0=10.

problems.title: Do not forget the integration constant
problems.question: For which of a=5,3,−8 is there a function F with F′(x)=2x such that F(x)+x⁸+a=0 has a real root?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: $F(x)=x^2+C$, where C is any real constant.
steps: For every proposed a,choose C=−a. Then x=0 solves x²+C+x⁸+a=0.
Thus all three parameter values work. Restricting C to zero would incorrectly discard the positive values.

problems.title: Eccentricity of a hyperbola
problems.question: Find eccentricity of x²/8²−y²/6²=1.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.

problems.title: Recover the minor semiaxis of an ellipse
problems.question: An ellipse has major-axis length34 and eccentricity15/17. Find a+b.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The other semiaxis is √(289−225)=8. Hence a+b=17+8=25.

problems.title: Differentiate implicit inverse trigonometric functions
problems.question: If tanα(x)=x and cotβ(x)=x,find (α+β)′.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: Differentiate both identities using sec²α=1+tan²α and csc²β=1+cot²β.
The derivatives cancel,so (α+β)′=0 on differentiable branches.
problems.note: The defining identities alone allow discontinuous choices of branches. The derivative question presumes differentiable local branches.

problems.title: Cancel the common chain-rule factor
problems.question: Let f=(x²+sin²x)⁴ and g=f′/[8(x²+sin²x)³]. Find g′(π/4).
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: Near π/4 the denominator is nonzero,so g=x+sinxcosx.
Then g′=1+cos2x; at π/4 this is 1.

problems.title: Find increasing intervals from a derivative sign chart
problems.question: Which listed interval has increasing y=x⁴/4−x³−x²/2+3x?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The derivative is positive on (−1,1) and (3,∞),and negative on the two intervening outside ranges.
Among the listed intervals,only [0,1] lies entirely in an increasing range.

problems.title: A point already on a parabola
problems.question: How many tangents to y²=9x pass through (4,6)?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: The point lies on the parabola because $6^2=9\cdot4$.
steps: A smooth parabola has exactly one tangent through a point on itself.
More explicitly,the tangent at parameter t is y=tx+9/(4t). Passing through (4,6) gives (4t−3)²=0,one slope t=3/4.

problems.title: Asymptotes of a hyperbola
problems.question: Which listed line is an asymptote of x²/45−y²/20=1?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The slopes simplify to ±2/3. Of the given choices,y=(2/3)x appears.

problems.title: Simplify a trigonometric integrand
problems.question: Integrate 2cos²(π/4−x/2)+cosx from 0 to π/4.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: An antiderivative is x−cosx+sinx.
Its value at π/4 is π/4 and at zero is −1. The integral is π/4+1.

problems.title: A tangent parallel to a given line
problems.question: Which listed point of f(x)=x³+2x² has tangent parallel to y=−x+7?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: Solve 3x²+4x+1=0,or (3x+1)(x+1)=0. Thus x=−1 or −1/3.
At x=−1,f=1,so (−1,1) is the listed point. The other valid tangent point is (−1/3,5/27),not listed.

problems.title: Distance between ellipse directrices
problems.question: Find distance between the directrices of x²/25+y²/21=1.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: Here a/e=5/(2/5)=25/2. The distance between the two vertical lines is 25.

problems.title: A horizontal plane with coefficients of arbitrary scale
problems.question: Plane Ax+By+Cz+D=0 is perpendicular to Oz and contains (3,5,1). Find A+B+C+D.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: The normal is parallel to Oz,so A=B=0,C≠0; the plane is z=1.
steps: Substitution gives C+D=0. Therefore A+B+C+D=0 regardless of the nonzero scale chosen for C.

problems.title: A cubic decreasing on the whole real axis
problems.question: For which listed a is f(x)=(a/3)x³+4x²+ax+7a²−11 decreasing everywhere?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: $f\prime=ax^2+8x+a$. Require f′≤0 for all real x.
steps: The quadratic must open downward and have no positive maximum. This requires a<0 and discriminant 64−4a²≤0.
Together these conditions give a≤−4. Among −8,−3,−2,0,4,7,only −8 qualifies.

problems.title: Minimise squared distance on a radical graph
problems.question: Find the minimum distance from (0,0) to y=√(10+x−2x²).
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: The domain is [−2,5/2]; squared distance is $d^2=x^2+y^2=10+x-x^2$.
steps: This concave quadratic attains its minimum on the closed interval at an endpoint.
At x=−2,the squared distance is4; at x=5/2,it is25/4. Thus the minimum distance is2,at (−2,0).

problems.title: Count nonvertical asymptotes
problems.question: How many asymptotes of form y=kx+b does f(x)=x/√(x²+x) have?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The right-hand infinite limit is1 and the left-hand infinite limit is−1. These give two horizontal asymptotes y=1 and y=−1.
The function stays bounded at both infinities,so it has no asymptote with nonzero slope.

problems.title: A quadrilateral from hyperbola axis points
problems.question: Find area of the quadrilateral with vertices at the foci and imaginary-axis endpoints of x²/13−y²/36=1.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: $c=\sqrt{13+36}=7$, b=6; the perpendicular diagonals have lengths 2c and 2b.
steps: The four vertices are (±7,0),(0,±6). Area is half the diagonal product: 14·12/2=84.

problems.title: Volume by circular cross sections
problems.question: Rotate the region under y=2x+1 from x=1 to4 about Ox. Find volume.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: An antiderivative is (2x+1)³/6.

problems.title: Maximise a derivative quadratic
problems.question: S(t)=18t+9t²−t³ and V(t)=S′(t). Find maximum V.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The square is nonnegative,so V≤45,with equality at t=3. This time is also nonnegative.
problems.note: The problem explicitly defines V as S′. Its maximum is45. If “speed” meant |S′| on an unlimited time range,it would be unbounded; that is a different interpretation.

problems.title: Use a common point of two curves
problems.question: Which listed A minimises AM+AN for some M on y=x⁴−x³ and N on y=5x²−12?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: A sum of distances is at least zero,and equals zero if A=M=N is a common curve point.
steps: At x=2,both functions equal8. Therefore A=(2,8) attains the absolute minimum zero.
To check uniqueness,the intersection equation factors as (x−2)²(x²+3x+3)=0. The quadratic has negative discriminant,so no other real intersection exists.

problems.title: Reduce an iterated function to a fixed point
problems.question: How many real solutions does f(f(x))=f(x) have for f(x)=fifth-root(3−x³−x)?
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: Put u=f(x). A fixed point satisfies $u^5+u^3+u-3=0$.
steps: The last polynomial is strictly increasing because its derivative is5u⁴+3u²+1>0. It vanishes at u=1,so u=1 is the only fixed point.
Now f(x)=1 gives x³+x=2,a strictly increasing equation whose sole root is x=1.

problems.title: Point-to-plane distance from axis intercepts
problems.question: A plane cuts the positive axes at distances2,1,2. Find its distance from (1,3,7).
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
steps: The numerator is |1+6+7−2|=12; the denominator is√6. Thus d=12/√6=2√6.

problems.title: Determine a normal from two perpendicularity conditions
problems.question: Plane Ax+By+Cz+D=0 contains the origin and (0,1,2),and is perpendicular to 3x−4y+5z−12=0. Find A/C.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: Containment gives D=0,B+2C=0; perpendicular planes have orthogonal normals: 3A−4B+5C=0.
steps: Substitute B=−2C into the normal equation: 3A+13C=0.
C cannot be zero,otherwise all coefficients vanish. Therefore A/C=−13/3.

problems.title: Area between two sideways parabolas and a line
problems.question: Find area bounded by y²=x,y²=2x,and y=x/2.
problems.idea: Identify the relevant derivative, integral or coordinate formula, then check its conditions.
formulas: Use horizontal slices: x=y²,x=y²/2,x=2y. Intersections with the line occur at y=0,2,4.
steps: For 0≤y≤2,the bounded region has width y²−y²/2=y²/2. For 2≤y≤4,the width is2y−y²/2.
Area=∫₀² y²/2 dy+∫₂⁴(2y−y²/2)dy=4/3+8/3=4.
